_comment: DOM selectors for the ESPN fantasy UI. Kept FLAT on purpose — test_login.js,
check_espn_session.js, draft_clicker.js and waiver_sniper.js all read these keys directly.
Recon on 2026-08-11 (src/bots/lineup_recon.js, league 1248158344) found that ESPN's roster
table exposes NO per-player identifier in the DOM: `tr[data-player-id]`, `tr[data-playerid]`
and any attribute matching /player.?id/i all return ZERO matches. Rows carry only `data-idx`,
a positional index. That is why lineup_bot.js drives ESPN's REST API instead of clicking
Consequence for other bots: waiver_sniper.js:29 and draft_clicker.js:27 both build
`tr[data-player-id=...]` locators, which cannot ever match. Both are known-broken and are
tracked in their own issues — not fixed here.
`roster_table` was `.roster-table`, which matched nothing; it is now the verified `.Table`.

_unverified.warning: Never matched against a real page. Do not assume these work.
